text: Inference is an inference (Anumana). Knowledge arising from consultation is inference (Anumiti). Knowledge of the property specific to the object being inferred is consultation (Paramarsha). For example, the knowledge "This mountain is smoky because it is pervaded by fire" is consultation. The knowledge "The mountain is burning" that arises from it is inference (Anumiti). The rule of co-occurrence, "Wherever there is smoke, there is fire," is the pervasion (Vyapti). The property of the object being inferred, such as being a mountain, is the property of the subject (Pakshadharma). ||40||
